purpose: Agent 3 (deterministic scheduling) and Agent 4 (rule-based risks): a plan whose dates, critical path, one resource conflict and rule verdict are known in advance. No LLM is needed to check it.

requirements.text: Customers can register, sign in and save an address
requirements.exact_quote: I want to pick a service, see the price and book a two-hour slot.

requirements.text: Customers can book a service with a time slot and pay by card
requirements.exact_quote: I pay by card when I book, and I must see the technician's name and rating.

requirements.text: Dispatchers can assign the nearest available technician and flag jobs nobody can take
requirements.exact_quote: I need a queue of unassigned jobs and one click to assign the nearest available technician.

requirements.text: Technicians can accept a job and move it through on the way, working and done
requirements.exact_quote: I accept, tap on my way, working and done, and I need the address and customer notes on the same screen.

requirements.text: Customers can rate the technician after the job
requirements.exact_quote: reviews ship with the first release

requirements.text: Admins can see daily jobs, revenue and technician load
requirements.exact_quote: Only an admin may see revenue

requirements.text: Roles are enforced on the server and card data is never stored
requirements.exact_quote: every role check must be enforced on the server, not in the app. Card data must never be stored on our servers.

requirements.text: The first release is live by 1 December 2026
requirements.exact_quote: FixMate's first release must be live by Tuesday, 1 December 2026.

stories.text: As a customer I can register, sign in and save my address
acceptance_criteria: A new account is created with a valid email.
An address can be saved and edited before booking.

stories.text: As a customer I can book a service slot and pay by card
acceptance_criteria: Only free slots for the chosen service are offered.
A card payment is confirmed before the booking exists.

stories.text: As a dispatcher I can assign the nearest available technician
acceptance_criteria: Unassigned jobs are listed oldest first.
A job nobody can take is flagged, never dropped.

stories.text: As a technician I can accept a job and update its status from my phone
acceptance_criteria: Status moves on the way, working, done.
The address and notes are on the status screen.

stories.text: As a customer I can rate the technician after the job is done
acceptance_criteria: Rating is only possible on a done job.
The rating appears on the technician profile.

stories.text: As an admin I can see daily jobs, revenue and technician load
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard shows today's jobs and revenue.
Technician load is shown per person.

stories.text: As the platform owner I enforce roles on the server and never store card data
acceptance_criteria: No card number is stored in the database.

stories.text: As the project sponsor I get the first release live by 1 December 2026
acceptance_criteria: The release is deployed and monitored before the pilot.
A go-live checklist is signed off by the PM.

tasks.title: Build auth and role-based access API
tasks.rationale: Every other feature needs a signed-in user; nothing can ship before this exists.

tasks.title: Build booking flow API
tasks.rationale: Dispatch, payments and the technician app all hang off a created booking.

tasks.title: Build customer booking screens
tasks.rationale: Turns the booking API into something a customer can actually use.

tasks.title: Build dispatch and nearest-technician engine
tasks.rationale: The core of the marketplace: without assignment the booking never reaches a technician.

tasks.title: Integrate card payments and invoicing
tasks.rationale: Money is taken at booking, so it can start as soon as the booking API exists.

tasks.title: Build technician app job status flow
tasks.rationale: The technician cannot start work until the assigned job reaches the phone.

tasks.title: Build admin dashboard for jobs, revenue and load
tasks.rationale: Needs both dispatched jobs and paid bookings to show daily numbers.

tasks.title: Build ratings and reviews
tasks.rationale: A review only exists after a done job, so it follows the technician status flow.

tasks.title: Add server-side role enforcement and card-data hardening
tasks.rationale: Protects every API built above and closes admin-only revenue access.

tasks.title: Deploy the release and set up monitoring
tasks.rationale: The pilot cannot start until the finished app is deployed and observed.
